capabilities: render Markdown notes as interactive mindmaps with headings, lists, tables, links and LaTeX
add, rename, move and delete nodes on the map, writing changes back to the note
navigate, select, fold and edit nodes with Vim-style keyboard shortcuts
rearrange subtrees with drag and drop
search nodes and focus the map on a selected subtree
extras: The README warns that the plugin writes directly to Markdown files and recommends keeping backups or versioning the vault (Git, Obsidian Sync) before editing large maps. Docs are also available in Simplified Chinese.
intentEvidence: an independent fork of Mindmap NextGen by James Tindal
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to restructure a note visually as a mindmap while keeping edits synced to the underlying Markdown source.

relations.evidence: Advanced Mindmap is built on Markmap
an independent fork of Mindmap NextGen by James Tindal

summary: Interactive mindmap editor that renders Markdown notes as editable maps and writes every node change straight back to the note file.
